##### Project general facts

Al Habtoor Tower is located along the Dubai Water Canal and forming a distinctive addition to the Dubai skyline. The tower offers an all-inclusive luxury living environment with stunning views of the city, Dubai Water Canal, and the sea. Designed as a vertical city, Al Habtoor Tower combines elegant residential spaces with a wide range of lifestyle amenities and services.

The development offers one- to three-bedroom apartments, with different floor plans available on each floor and living areas ranging from 78 to 219 sq.m. The residences feature one or more balconies and are designed to provide spacious contemporary living with views of the Dubai skyline and Burj Khalifa. Residents also benefit from modern facilities, including state-of-the-art fitness centres, infinity pools, and 18 high-speed elevators.

The apartments are ready to move into and feature modern finishes made with high-quality materials. Each residence includes fully equipped kitchens and complete bathrooms with the necessary furnishings and household appliances. The apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their living spaces according to their individual preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Habtoor City is a prominent mixed-use development situated along Sheikh Zayed Road, close to the Dubai Water Canal and Downtown Dubai. The community combines residential, hospitality, entertainment, dining, and recreational facilities within one strategically located destination, providing residents and visitors with convenient access to key areas of the city.

The development is well known for its entertainment offerings, with La Perle by Dragone serving as its centerpiece. The state-of-the-art theatre hosts an aquatic and acrobatic show featuring water effects, stunts, and artistic performances. Al Habtoor City also offers a variety of dining venues, retail outlets, and recreational facilities, providing a diverse range of options for leisure and everyday activities.

The waterfront setting further enhances the lifestyle appeal of Al Habtoor City, with a promenade along the Dubai Water Canal providing a picturesque environment for leisurely walks and outdoor activities. Its location along Sheikh Zayed Road also offers convenient connectivity to Downtown Dubai and other key destinations across the city, combining accessibility with a vibrant urban lifestyle.
